newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end mixed, erasing earlier gain.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end mixed, erasing earlier gain.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed mixed on Tuesday, as technical selling by local investors erased earlier gains, traders said.
Prices ranged from 140 yen lower to 40 yen higher, with the most-active January 1998 contract down 110 yen at 14,690 yen per tonne. The day's volume was 118,336 lots.

Most contracts rallied from the opening, reflecting the Chicago market's price gains overnight, traders said. But market sentiment turned bearish as technical selling emerged in the afternoon, they said.
The spot March corn contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $2.68 per bushel at 0815 GMT, up from $2.67-1/4 at Monday's close.
The spot January of the CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $7.32-1/2 at 0815 GMT, against $7.32-3/4 at Monday's close.
